note: GFP recreation area on a point in Lake Francis Case (Missouri River), 20 mi northwest of Platte off SD-44, where Lewis and Clark were told to watch for the 'burning bluffs': two loops of electric back-in sites, three camping cabins and three group sites with shore access. The east row (10E and 12E) faces the lake across open grass and beach; the west loop sits inland. Boat ramp, fish-cleaning station, playground and group shelter. Showers, flush toilets and other water systems may be shut Oct-Apr; vault toilets stay open. --Claude
